# CGRX v0.1.0-alpha.10

This alpha focuses on fail-closed graph correctness, deterministic retrieval, and safer language expansion.

- Fixes hybrid retrieval mode isolation so parallel baseline/hybrid queries cannot race through process-global configuration.
- Restores blocking language-coverage validation and keeps the default production registry limited to the seven reviewed packs: Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript/TSX, Python, C and Kotlin.
- Restores TypeScript inventory-cache regressions and hardens extraction/index migration behavior.
- Adds an opt-in `experimental-php` validation pipeline across all six declared PHP extensions.
- Adds exact same-file PHP function proofs with source-bound caller/target identities, persistence/reopen/refresh validation, stale-proof rejection and cache isolation.
- Adds namespace-aware same-file PHP type references and used-import proofs, including aliases, groups, exact evidence spans and corruption-resistant rebuilds.
- Keeps unsupported PHP dispatch, external namespace/import targets, Composer/autoloader behavior, and ambiguous identities explicit as unresolved rather than guessed.
- Hardens lifecycle synchronization and preserves strict Linux/macOS CI, integration smoke tests and evaluator gates.
- Adds a release pipeline that validates the exact Apple Silicon candidate before merge and refuses to reuse an existing tag/release pointing at a different commit.

The downloadable Apple Silicon archive is accompanied by `SHA256SUMS`. Linux and Intel macOS remain pinned source-install paths with Rust 1.89.0.
